character: Main village of La Plagne at 2,000m. Purpose-built 1970s. Central hub with supermarket, bakery, ski rentals, pharmacy, tourist office. Ski-in/ski-out. Free shuttle to other villages.
dining: Selection of restaurants in the centre. Piste-side, pizza, Savoyard.
shopping: Supermarket, bakery, ski rental, sports shops, souvenirs, pharmacy, post office, banks, tourist office.
apres_scene: Lively apres in centre. Le Subsonik, Le Reflet, Pub Le Vaudiola.
activities_nearby: Ice rink, climbing wall, cinema, bowling, swimming pool, snowpark, toboggan runs. Access to Paradiski (425km).
